setup: git diff --quiet "$BASE" HEAD -- pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml .npmrc patches || pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

jobs.test-solidity: forge build --root solidity/template && pnpm exec turbo run test --filter='./solidity/*'
jobs.build: forge build --root solidity/template && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./solidity/*' $AFFECTED
